title: Lk's Attire — Admin Dashboard
tagline: The back office that runs the Lk's Attire shop
description: The admin dashboard behind the Lk's Attire shop, in its Soft-UI purple and pink design: today's sales and orders, the order pipeline from pending to delivered with invoice and shipping-label printing, products with variants, SKUs, discounts, free delivery and a live shop preview, stock, customers, coupons, homepage banners, reviews, delivery zones, staff roles, reports and the activity log — in Bangla and English. It is the real admin code running in the browser, sharing its data with the shop demo.
highlights: Opens straight into the dashboard — no sign-in needed
Search a customer by invoice no, phone, name, TrxID or SKU
Order pipeline: confirm, pack, ship with courier tracking, deliver, return, refund
Product editor with % or ৳ discounts, free or fixed delivery, and a live shop preview
Change the logo, top banner, offer strip, bKash/Nagad numbers and SMS texts without code
Low-stock alerts, reviews to approve and new-order notifications
46 fictional orders over ten weeks, so the charts and reports have something to show

credentials.label: Admin dashboard sign-in
credentials.note: Opens already signed in. After Sign out, sign back in with these (they are filled in for you). Everything is fictional demo data kept in your browser — change anything; add ?demo-reset to the address to start fresh.
